scripts.test:integration: RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 MAIL__SUPPRESS_SEND=${MAIL__SUPPRESS_SEND:-1} uv run pytest -c pyproject.toml -m integration
scripts.db:migrate: uv run python -m tortoise -c src.core.database.orm.TORTOISE_ORM makemigrations
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run python -m tortoise -c src.core.database.orm.TORTOISE_ORM upgrade
scripts.jobs:worker: uv run taskiq worker src.infra.jobs.taskiq_app:broker src.infra.jobs.tasks
scripts.jobs:scheduler: uv run taskiq scheduler src.infra.jobs.taskiq_app:scheduler src.infra.jobs.tasks
